messages:
ria (cs): Quick capture from a trial onboarding with ClearCo (Priya). Key asks: 1) a per-route billing switch in Console so they can disable embeddings for internal teams, 2) intermittent 504s during bulk embeddings ingest, and 3) an exportable per-route usage CSV for renewal. They said renewal depends on cost transparency.

noah (product): Thanks Ria. Can you paste Priya's exact error description and any repro steps? This looks like a trial retention risk.

ria (cs): Priya: "When we bulk upload ~50k vectors split across a few jobs, we see ~10-15% of requests return 504 after ~5-10m. It stalls our pipeline." Repro: 3 parallel jobs hitting /v1/embeddings, burst concurrency. I'll DM traces.

sam (cs): Finance asked for cost/day by route in a CSV they can attach to renewal decks. Can we add that to exports?

owen (eng): 504s often come from batching timeouts or model fallback retries. @noah please send trace ids. I'll check batching queues and model fallback logs for that tenant.

noah (product): Created RF-4201 to track. infra-bot: please link relevant tenant metrics.

infra-bot: RF-4201 created: clearco-embed-bulk-failures. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/clearco-embeds. :white_check_mark:

ria (cs): Marking account health: "at-risk" for renewal if cost visibility not solved within 3 weeks. Will follow up with Priya with a mitigation note.

owen (eng): Initial look: spikes align with concurrent job bursts and a series of short model fallbacks. Posting logs to RF-4201. Hypothesis: backlog + fallback thrash.

noah (product): Short-term mitigation: advise ClearCo to limit concurrency + use exponential backoff. Sam, can you draft a 1-pager + curl snippet for CSMs?

sam (cs): Drafting now. Will include: curl snippet to limit concurrency and batch size, steps to export per-route usage from Console, and suggested email text for finance. Snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"batch_size":500,"concurrency":2}'```

noah (product): Longer-term: product to evaluate per-route billing toggle as a Q2 quickship (low-risk UI change). If feasible, prioritize for mid-trial accounts.

ria (cs): I'll update the account health spreadsheet and set a renewal touch reminder. Priya said they'd accept the workaround if we provide step-by-step and temporary CSV export.

owen (eng): I'll continue debugging RF-4201 and post ETA for a fix or mitigation changes.

noah (product): Thanks team. Action items: RF-4201 triage (product+eng), enablement note (Sam), account health update (Ria).
